---
title: "Project Dashboard"
description: "Audit project QC, workflow state, provenance, search quality and resume status from the active ProtVis_dataset."
---

## Purpose

**Project Dashboard** is the project-wide audit page in ProtVis 0.9.1. Open it after Project init, database search or preprocessing to answer four questions: what data are active, whether the matrix is sufficiently complete, which runs are current/failed/invalidated, and where the project can safely resume.

The dashboard reads the active `ProtVis_dataset`; it does not create an alternative copy of the project.

## Top-level metrics

The summary cards report protein count, sample count, data completeness, median protein CV and completed workflow stages. A sample-level missing-value plot complements these project-wide metrics.

A staging Raw project can legitimately have zero proteins before database search. In that state, continue to **Search** rather than treating the empty expression matrix as a QC failure.

## Workflow state

The workflow card and tables use the schema-v4 dependency graph. Nodes can be complete, failed or invalidated. When an upstream step is re-run, downstream results that depend on the previous upstream state can be marked invalid instead of being presented as current.

A result can therefore remain in immutable history while no longer being valid for the currently activated data state.

## Dashboard tabs

| Tab | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Sample QC** | Sample-level missingness/intensity and related QC summaries |
| **Pipeline stages** | Stage-level processing status |
| **Run registry** | Immutable schema-v4 analysis runs |
| **Workflow nodes** | Dependency-aware workflow nodes |
| **Workflow edges** | Parent/dependency relationships |
| **Provenance** | Software, parameters, lineage and recorded events |
| **Input files** | Registered files and fingerprints |
| **Search QC** | Search-level quality metrics |
| **Search runs** | Per-run search summaries |

For Sage, search QC can include IDs, precursor charge, precursor mass error, q-values, peptide length, missed cleavages and retention time. FragPipe contributes parsed PSM/peptide/protein counts and compatible search summaries.

## Resume workflow

Click **Resume workflow** to continue from the newest valid checkpoint/node. Resume is dependency-aware: a project in `Sage_staging` is sent back to Search rather than entering quantitative preprocessing without a real protein matrix.

If a node failed, inspect the recorded error and inputs before retrying. Re-running a node records a new run and preserves earlier failed/history entries.

## HTML report

Use **HTML report** to capture a portable QC snapshot of the project state. For publication or archiving, keep this report together with the exported `ProtVis_dataset`, workflow/status tables and result registry.

## Recommended review points

Open Project Dashboard after **Project init**, after **Sage/FragPipe Search**, after shared preprocessing, before final DEP/enrichment interpretation, and before project release.

::: {.callout-tip}
The dashboard is an audit surface, not a replacement for module-specific plots. Use it to establish which data state and run are current, then interpret biological figures in their dedicated modules.
:::
